data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 83.1m (2013: GBP 59.1m) is an improvement of GBP 6.4m to claims reserves established at the prior year end.

prior_year_events.impact_description: resolution of certain legacy issues has had an appreciable favourable impact on incurred claims, leading to reserve releases.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net release of GBP 6.4 million in prior year claims reserves, primarily driven by favourable claims development. This included attritional losses not developing as anticipated, improvements on previously held catastrophe loss reserves, and a generally benign catastrophe year. These positive developments were observed across multiple classes, notably Marine (Hull & Liability), Starr Tech Onshore, and Property. The resolution of certain legacy issues also contributed to favourable incurred claims.
raw_causal_phrases: material reserve improvements on the 2012 & Prior years of account
lower than expected attritional and large loss activity
resolution of certain legacy issues has had an appreciable favourable impact on incurred claims
attritional losses not developing as originally anticipated
improvements on previously held catastrophe loss reserves

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development amount is reported as net of reinsurance, as a gross figure was not explicitly available.
